Career

Keeper's gloves on. Bat in hand. Ball when the team needs it. Hanuma Chowdary is a batting allrounder from Memphis, Tennessee — a right-hand batter, right-arm medium bowler and wicket-keeper, wearing jersey 111 — and his story runs from SRKIT college cricket to leading BYCC Syndicate into the MPL 2026 final.

2016–2020 · SRKIT, college cricket. Where it all began — school and college cricket, leading his team to the semi-finals.

2022 · Memphis breakthrough. Player of the Tournament and Man of the Final as Telugu Warriors won the 1st Annual Memphis Cricket Tournament — then a captain's tournament win in the LPL that November, sealed on the last ball in −2° cold.

2023 · Dallas. Joined The Game Changers and finished Summer 2023 as the team's leading run-scorer, with 103* off 53 balls vs Rangers — and 48 off 28 balls vs LazzyLADS.

2024 · The Orange Cap season. 296 runs in 6 innings at an average of 74 in MPL 2024, plus Man of the Series (MVP) and Most Sixes in MPL T-20 2024.

2025 · The hundred and the Purple Cap. 102* off 59 balls vs Warriors in MPL 2025, the Purple Cap for most wickets in MML T30 2025, and an MPL Season 9 2025 title with BYCC Syndicate, beating Indian Lions by 7 wickets on 2 Nov 2025.

2026 · Leading BYCC Syndicate into the MPL final. After dominating the league all season, BYCC Syndicate reached the MPL 2026 final vs Indian Lions on Saturday, 31 Oct 2026, at Hickory Hill — one win from lifting the trophy again. In CCL 2026 he also turned out for Telugu Warriors in T1 (101 runs, 11 wickets) and Gabbar Kings in T2 (79 runs, 10 wickets at an economy of 5.26).

Frequently Asked Questions

What does he do in the field?

Plenty. On CricHeroes his fielding record reads 69 catches, 11 caught behind, 11 run outs and 3 stumpings — and that is before the headline moment: 6 catches in a single innings as wicketkeeper in DCL Summer 2023. In CCL T15 2026 T2 alone he took 8 catches for Gabbar Kings. Whether he is behind the stumps, in the outfield, or throwing down the stumps on the run, fielding is not a rest between overs for him — it is another way to change a match.

How does he perform with leather ball vs tennis ball?

Both, and well. With leather ball he has played 68 matches for 1,644 runs at 30.44, with best bowling of 4/16. With tennis ball he has played 148 matches for 2,211 runs, with best bowling of 7/4. The split shows a player who did not just move between formats and cities — he moved between balls, conditions and leagues, and kept scoring and taking wickets in all of them.

How many finals has he played, and what did he win?

Ten finals, five won and five runner-up. The wins: the 1st Annual Memphis Cricket Tournament in 2022 with Telugu Warriors, the LPL in November 2022 as captain, the DCL Summer 2023 Division H championship with The Game Changers, MPL Season 9 in 2025 with BYCC Syndicate, and the MML TennisBall T15 final in November 2025 with Gabbar Kings. The runner-up finishes include the Champions Cricket League final in 2023 with Frisco Blasters, MPL Tape10 2024, the Collierville Division 2 final in August 2024, MML T30 2025, and the Arkansas Cup in 2025.

What are his biggest tournament honours?

Forty-seven awards in all, and the headline ones tell the story: Player of the Tournament and Man of the Final in the 1st Annual Memphis Cricket Tournament, No. 1 with 494 points in KISO League 4, Man of the Series in MPL T-20 2024, the Orange Cap in MPL 2024 with 296 runs in 6 innings at an average of 74, the Purple Cap for most wickets in MML T30 2025, Most Sixes in MPL T-20 2024, and most catches in an innings with 6 as wicketkeeper. Around those sit 12 Player of the Match, 14 Best Batter and 5 Best Bowler match awards.

Which hundred came first, and how are they different?

The Dallas hundred came first: 103* off 53 balls for The Game Changers on 6 August 2023, scored on the very last ball of a T20 tape-ball match vs Rangers, in the same game Sagar scored 118 off 54. Two years later came the second: 102* off 59 balls vs Warriors in MPL 2025 for BYCC Syndicate. One was a last-ball tape-ball classic, the other a franchise-league hundred — together they are the two hundreds in a career of 4,002 runs.
